# Public-Record Watch

> Free, no-signup, no-upload tool that compares two dated public-register snapshots (licenses, permits, registrations) in your browser and reports what changed. Runs entirely client-side.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
